decisions.choice: Open the store's front door to plain addresses and keep the real guards. (1) The Worker and middleware boundary lets any plain GET or HEAD address (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore, tilde; not under /api, /_emdash or an underscore or dot prefix) reach the site, which answers not found for anything it does not have; the demo-era approved-address list no longer decides what exists.
